Using perimeter coordinates modulo 400:

- A’s position: \(5t \pmod{400}\)
- B’s position: \(250+10t \pmod{400}\)

For \(0 \le t < 20\), A is on side AB (index 0).  
For B, starting at 250 m:

- \(0 \le t < 5\): side CD
- \(5 \le t < 15\): side DA
- \(15 \le t < 25\): side AB

At \(t=15\), B reaches position \(250+150=400 \equiv 0\), so B is at corner A/on side AB, while A is at \(75\) m on side AB. Thus they are first on the same side.

\boxed{15}
